script_text: Mercury, your ruling planet, forms a powerful sextile to disciplined Saturn in your 10th House of career on Monday — pitch that bold project or ask for the raise you deserve. Tuesday carries friction as the Sun squares Pluto in your 5th House of romance, so avoid emotional power plays and impulsive flirting. Wednesday is your turning point: Venus enters your 4th House of home and family, softening your world and drawing someone from your past closer to your heart. Thursday through Sunday, a Mercury-Neptune trine through your 11th House opens intuitive channels within your social circle — a friend may connect you to an opportunity that transforms your income this season. Monday is your power day for career breakthroughs. Tuesday is your worst day for love. This week, lean into Virgo's methodical Mercury energy and let careful strategy guide your every move. Follow for daily updates.
